verdict.rationale: Slate's own orchestration feature lets you spin up multiple background agents to work on several tasks at once, which gives a form of parallel, multi-item execution. However, the docs describe concurrent tasks, not a bulk operation that applies one action across many selected items. missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation (one action applied across many items such as files, sessions or records), documented scope or limits of batch execution, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Parallelize working and orchestration of many tasks at once.
spin up more agents to parallelize work across several tasks at once
Those agents show up as a grid of inline subagent cards, one per agent.
